reason: Ridge uses unnormalized SSE plus alpha penalty. With tens to hundreds of thousands of transaction rows, the pilot-scale upper bound 100 may not test strong shrinkage. Widen in advance, rather than diagnosing the boundary from final outcomes.
ridge_scope: same alpha grid for metadata-only, image-only, and early concatenation in both collections; selection remains inner temporal CV

implementation_clarifications.feature_encoding: training-fit category-specific one-hot; drop=None; handle_unknown=ignore with counts reported
implementation_clarifications.constant_features: remove zero-variance columns using training only
implementation_clarifications.target_scaling: none beyond ln(P/B); LinearSVR epsilon and ElasticNet alpha on this target scale
implementation_clarifications.tie_rule: pooled inner MSE within absolute 1e-12; prefer larger alpha
implementation_clarifications.extra_control: fixed zero log-relative-price, equivalent to predicting prior collection median; diagnostic only
implementation_clarifications.other_models_in_this_stage: bounded chronological smoke tests only, no accuracy ranking
